source_description_html:
LighTech carbon accessories are offered with a glossy finish and, for some motorcycle models, the matte version is also available. Carbon stands out for its lightness compared to standard components and gives the bike a more race and aggressive look. The material used is of the highest quality, thanks also to the meticulous workmanship carried out in many cases in an autoclave, which makes it extremely resistant. To clean the products we recommend the use of neutral detergents (to avoid damaging the surface). LighTech carbon accessories are very easy to apply to the motorbike (in many cases a few drops of silicone are sufficient in the support points or, in other cases, LighTech provides the screws for assembly inside the package). Item sold individually. Glossy version.
